summary:
Five STRONG type contradictions settled by chapter accounting. THE HEADLINE: four of the five are the SAME defect in opposite directions and both labels are wrong somewhere — ONE row (417) is stored filler and is really MIXED (it holds the sole adaptation of ch 666's closing third), and THREE rows (460, 461, 469) are stored mixed and are really FILLER (zero first-time manga pages between them; two carry manual anchors that A1 forbids and that must be DELETED). The fifth (429) is CONFIRMED AS STORED: AFL is right and AFG's blue class is a 30-second viewing-guide opinion.

SOURCE LINEAGE (wave 1 established it and it holds here): AFG's chapter column and Narutopedia's episode infobox agree token for token on this series (415 = 665,666 / 418 = 667,668 / 419 = 668 / 429 = 678 / 459 = 679,680,681 / 462 = 681 / 463 = 681,682,683, and BOTH are silent on 416, 428, 430, 460, 461, 469) — count them as ONE leg. The two independent legs used throughout are (a) ja-WP's episode list, whose legend at the head of the tables reads 'サブタイトルが太字の回は、全編がアニメオリジナルストーリーの回。それ以外は原作ストーリーもしくは原作ストーリーとアニメオリジナルがミックスされた回' — BOLD subtitle = the WHOLE episode is anime-original, unmarked = manga story or a mix; and (b) TV Tokyo's own per-episode back-number synopses (the licensor), keyed by 通算話 (our 417 = 第637話, 429 = 第649話, 460 = 第680話, 461 = 第681話, 469 = 第689話 — ja-WP's 通算話 column gives the join and TV Tokyo's finale 第720話 = our ep 500 confirms it).

EP 417 'You'll Be My Backup' — stored filler (AFL), AFG Mixed 16:54→end, Narutopedia chapters=666. TRUE: MIXED. ja-WP leaves 417 UNMARKED while bolding its own twin 416 結成・ミナト班 and the whole run 422/423, 427/428, 429, 430, 431 around it — an under-marking legend leaving an adjacent row unmarked is the positive claim. TV Tokyo's 第637話 synopsis ends '――そして舞台は戻りマダラと対峙するオビトとカカシ。二人の最後の作戦が今始まる!!' ('and the stage returns: Obito and Kakashi facing Madara — their final plan begins now'). Those last ~4½ minutes are ch 666's CLOSING THIRD, adapted in no other episode: ep 415 stops at 'Kakashi rallies to Obito's side' (Narutopedia's ep-415 summary ends there and the ch-666 page's own <section end> break falls at the same sentence; AFG's ep-415 window is 1:30-13:09), ep 416 has no chapter field on either source, and ep 418 = 667-668, ep 419 = 668. So the sole-adaptation exception fires on both halves and the row carries the anchor — which is the point: left filler, ch 666's final pages would be marked never-adapted and the reader would be handed ep 415 as if it finished the chapter.

EP 429 'Killer B Rappūden Part 1' — CONFIRMED AS STORED (filler). AFG's own note sizes its claim: 'we only watch from 0:00 to 0:30' — thirty seconds of a ~21-minute episode, the establishing beat of B falling under the Infinite Tsukuyomi. ja-WP BOLDS 429 (全編アニメオリジナル), TV Tokyo's 第649話 synopsis is the dream world start to finish ('無限月読にかかったキラービーが見る夢――'), and Narutopedia's Killer B article marks the whole scenario 'In the anime, Killer B dreamed of a world where…<ref>episode 429</ref>'. The ch-678 tie is a SLIVER and a DUPLICATE (678 is adapted in eps 451 and 458, and 426 carries 677's casting) — a trivial first-time beat at best, so the sole-adaptation exception does not fire. AFG's class lied; its minute note told the truth.

EPS 460 'Kaguya Ōtsutsuki' + 461 'Hagoromo and Hamura' — stored MIXED with manual anchors 681; TRUE: FILLER, anchors to be DELETED (A1). ja-WP bolds BOTH while leaving 459, 462, 463 and 470 unmarked (four adjacent controls), and its アニメ版オリジナルストーリー section says of this arc in as many words: 'ハゴロモとハムラがカグヤと敵対した経緯やインドラとアシュラの確執は原作でも断片的に書かれているが、カグヤの過去は完全にアニメオリジナルであり' — Kaguya's past is COMPLETELY anime-original. TV Tokyo's 第680話/第681話 synopses are the Land of Ancestors, emperor Tenji, and Gamamaru at the Peak of Demise — none of which exists in the manga. Narutopedia's own Kaguya article prefixes exactly this material 'In the anime, Kaguya was discovered by the people of the Land of Ancestors<ref name="NS460"/>' and 'In the anime, not wanting mankind to perish, she freed some victims<ref name="NS461"/>'. AFG marks both rows red with chapter N/A while printing 681 on 462 and 679-681 on 459 — a discriminating column, not a plateau. The chapters=681 in the infobox is the Black Zetsu NARRATION FRAME only, and every page of ch 681 is already accounted for: ep 459 runs to Black Zetsu beginning the tale, ep 462 animates the tale itself (AFG 'from minute 10:40 until the end, that follows the story that Zetsu tells… read manga 681'), ep 463 = 681-683. Nothing is first-time in 460/461. AFL lied here (its Mixed Canon/Filler bucket), and batch 15 promoted the frame to an anchor before the sliver clause existed.

EP 469 'A Special Mission' — stored MIXED (AFL); TRUE: FILLER. This is the Kakashi's-face caper: a Part-I-era comedy with the Third Hokage alive and Sasuke still on Team 7, built entirely around Sukea, an anime-original disguise (Narutopedia has no separate article — 'Sukea' redirects to Kakashi Hatake). Narutopedia's episode page carries NO chapters field and NO arc field at all — and that silence is framed by positive fields on 459/462/463/470 either side of it. ja-WP BOLDS it; AFG marks it red / N/A; TV Tokyo's 第689話 entry is a two-line teaser with no story beat. Not one source names a chapter. AFL is alone and wrong.

WHO LIED, in one line each: AFL mis-typed 417 (block-typed the 416-417 flashback pair filler and missed the present-day close) and mis-typed 460/461/469 mixed; AFG mis-classed 417 correctly but 429 wrongly (a 30-second frame promoted to a blue class) — on 460/461/469 AFG's red class is RIGHT and it is AFL that is wrong, which is the reverse of the wave's usual shape.

anchors.chapters_adapted: 666 (closing third: Obito's 'the legend can witness a paired Sharingan', Madara's twin Truth-Seeking Balls, the synchronised Kamui that doubles the transfer speed, Obito reaching Kamui's dimension and convincing Sakura, the Tailed Beast Transfer Technique begun on Naruto, Guy's arrival saving Kakashi from Madara's orb)
anchors.note: A4/A10/A13: the episode's only source content is the closing third of ch 666, animated from 16:54 to the end (AFG's own timed window) — START = END = 666, one chapter, page-partitioned with ep 415. 'Pages, not numbers' (Sean 2026-08-27): these are FIRST-TIME pages, so they are a real position even though ch 666 was already ep 415's END; the anchor does not advance the frontier and must not be read as doing so (415 → 666, 417 → 666, 418 → 668 is monotone). THE PAGE SPLIT, proved on the source's own text: Narutopedia's ch-666 page breaks its summary at '…As Kakashi rallies to Obito's side', and Narutopedia's ep-415 summary ends on exactly that sentence ('Kakashi runs to Obito's side, with his old comrade commenting on how Kakashi always looks down upon him, remembering the old times in Konohagakure') — the cue into the 416-417 flashback. Everything after that break (paired Sharingan → two orbs → synchronised Kamui → Sakura → tailed-beast transfer → Guy saves Kakashi, ch 666's last panel) is ep 417's close, and TV Tokyo's 第637話 synopsis names it: '――そして舞台は戻りマダラと対峙するオビトとカカシ。二人の最後の作戦が今始まる!!'. Nothing re-covers it: ep 416 has no chapter field on Narutopedia or AFG, ep 418 = 667-668, ep 419 = 668. Volume 69 per the stored boundary table (658-668) and Narutopedia's ch-666 infobox (volume=69). CONDITIONAL ON THE TYPE CORRECTION: A1 forbids this anchor if Sean leaves the row filler — in that case take the anchor_hostile entry filed for 417 instead.

continue_points.note: C2 parity with the anime: ch 666 is FINISHED here (ep 417 animates through its last panel — Guy's arrival), and the next canon row, ep 418, starts at ch 667 ('The End of Youthful Days' / Viz 'The End to Blue Days') on both Narutopedia and AFG. So the reader resumes at 667 with nothing skipped. This also repairs a live hole: today ep 415 is recorded {665-666} with no continue, which tells the reader ch 666 is complete after 415 — it is not (see the ep-415 repair).

OUTSIDE THE ASK, but it follows necessarily from the ep-417 finding and the row is wrong without it. C1: ep 415 stops INSIDE ch 666 — after Obito extracts fragments of Shukaku's and Gyūki's chakra, orders Kakashi to teleport Naruto and Sakura away, is stopped by Madara's orb, and Kakashi rallies to his side. Ch 666's remaining pages are animated at the end of ep 417 (eps 416-417 are the inserted anime-original Team Minato flashback). Resume IN ch 666.

anchor_hostile.why: FALLBACK ONLY — file this entry instead of the anchor if Sean declines the type correction to mixed. A1: a filler row takes no anchor, and ch 666's closing third would then be recorded nowhere. My recommendation is the anchor; this entry exists so the alternative is not silent.

A1 + A44. The row is filler (confirmed as stored) and its ch-678 tie is position-less: a ~30-second establishing beat (AFG: 'we only watch from 0:00 to 0:30') showing Killer B falling under the Infinite Tsukuyomi, inside a 21-minute anime-original dream story. It is also a DUPLICATE — ch 678 is adapted in eps 451 ('Birth and Death', AFG 677/678/NOVEL; stored anchor {677-678}) and 458 ('Truth', AFG NOVEL/678/679; stored anchor {678-679}), with ep 455 carrying a 678 frame. Sole-adaptation exception checked and REFUSED on both halves: not sole, and 'B is caught by the genjutsu like everyone else' is a trivial beat, not a death / reveal / arc close.

A1 + A44 once the row is filler. The stored anchor 681 [681] is the Black Zetsu NARRATION FRAME, not a position: every page of ch 681 is animated elsewhere — ep 459 runs to Black Zetsu beginning the tale (Narutopedia ep-459 summary's last sentence), ep 462 animates the tale itself (AFG: 'from minute 10:40 until the end, that follows the story that Zetsu tells… read manga 681'), ep 463 = 681-683. The episode's own plot — the meteorite, emperor Tenji, Aino, Suzaku and Genbu, the Land of That border war, the execution decree — has no manga counterpart at all (ja-WP: 'カグヤの過去は完全にアニメオリジナル'). Its closing beat (Kaguya eats the chakra fruit, awakens the Rinne Sharingan, casts the Infinite Tsukuyomi) is a RESTAGING of Hagoromo's account in ch 670-671, animated in eps 420-421 — a duplicate, and Narutopedia credits 460 with no 670/671 pages.

A1 + A44 once the row is filler. Same shape as 460 and the same stored 681 frame. The episode is Gamamaru damming the stream, the bear, the fraudulent medicine salesman, Haori's God-Tree ritual, the Memory Stone at Mount Myōboku and Hagoromo learning Sage power — all anime-original (TV Tokyo 第681話: '後の大ガマ仙人・ガマ丸（まる）が姿を現す… 終焉の峠'; ja-WP bolds the row and says Kaguya's past is entirely anime-original). No page of ch 681 is first-time here.

A1: filler, and no source names a chapter — Narutopedia's episode page has NO chapters field and no arc field (its neighbours 459/462/463/470 all carry one), AFG prints N/A, ja-WP bolds it, TV Tokyo's 第689話 entry is a two-line teaser. The episode is set in the Part I era (the Third Hokage alive, Sasuke on Team 7) around Sukea, an anime-original disguise with no article of its own on Narutopedia ('Sukea' redirects to Kakashi Hatake). There is no chapter space for this row to sit in.

annotations.note: weight: SIGNIFICANT — because it is a complete, story-carrying sequence with its own resolution (Obito and Kakashi synchronise Kamui, Obito reaches the other dimension and BEGINS the Tailed Beast Transfer that will revive Naruto; Guy's arrival opens the Eight-Gates run that eps 418-421 are made of), and it is NEW material, not a duplicate: ep 415 animates ch 666 only up to Kakashi rallying to Obito's side, ep 416 adapts nothing, ep 418 starts at 667. Size is not the test, but for the record AFG times it at 16:54 → end, roughly 4½ minutes of a ~21-minute episode. This is the sole adaptation of these pages in the whole series.

The first ~17 minutes are the second half of the anime-original Team Minato decoy-scroll mission begun in ep 416 — Rin and Kakashi ambushed by the traitorous escortees, the fake scrolls, Kakashi's 'the mission is my nindō', Minato's rescue, and the reveal that Team Minato was itself the decoy. None of it is in the manga (Narutopedia's own Trivia even flags a continuity error: Kakashi uses the Chidori here, which Team Minato canonically did not know until the Kannabi Bridge mission). Newly animated production, not recap — so it weighs toward filler under the recap boundary (shippuden 388), and with a real, sole canon share in the same episode the row is MIXED (T28).

weight: SLIVER — because it is a ~30-second establishing beat (AFG's own window, 0:00-0:30, of a ~21-minute episode): Killer B, having survived the tailed-beast extraction, falls under the Infinite Tsukuyomi. It progresses nothing of the source's own story and carries no resolution; the remainder of the episode is the anime-original chibi-jinchūriki dream. DUPLICATE, not new: ch 678 is adapted properly in eps 451 and 458 (and its frame recurs in 455), and ch 677's casting of the genjutsu is ep 426. Earns neither a type nor an anchor. Note the honest tension: ja-WP bolds this row as 全編アニメオリジナル (the whole episode anime-original), which is consistent with the 30 seconds being restaged / re-shown framing rather than fresh adaptation — I could not establish from any source whether that half-minute is recycled footage from ep 426 or newly drawn, and the standing is the same either way (weightless under both the recap clause and the sliver clause).

weight: SLIVER — because the only source-tied material in either episode is the cut-back framing of Black Zetsu narrating to Naruto and Sasuke ('Black Zetsu begins telling Naruto and Sasuke the tale of Kaguya' / 'Black Zetsu continues telling Kaguya's story' — the opening clause of each Narutopedia summary and nothing else in them). It is a DUPLICATE: ch 681's pages are fully accounted for by ep 459 (up to Black Zetsu beginning the tale), ep 462 (the tale itself — AFG: 'from minute 10:40 until the end… read manga 681') and ep 463 (681-683). 681 is adapted properly in ep 462. Everything these two episodes actually dramatise — Tenji, Aino, the Land of Ancestors, the border war, Gamamaru, Haori, the God-Tree ritual, the Memory Stone — is anime-original: ja-WP states it outright ('カグヤの過去は完全にアニメオリジナルであり、ハゴロモとハムラの父親と思われる人物も登場する') and Narutopedia's Kaguya article prefixes the same material 'In the anime…' citing episodes 460 and 461. Ep 460's closing beat (the chakra fruit, the Rinne Sharingan, the Infinite Tsukuyomi) restages Hagoromo's ch 670-671 account already animated in eps 420-421 — also a duplicate. Earns neither a type nor an anchor.

type_corrections.note: Stored FILLER (AFL). Per-segment weights: (a) ~17 minutes, anime-original Team Minato decoy-scroll mission, second half of the pair begun in ep 416 — no manga counterpart, newly animated (not recap), weighs toward filler; (b) ~4½ minutes (AFG 16:54 → end), ch 666's closing third — weight SIGNIFICANT. T28 SOLE-ADAPTATION EXCEPTION, both halves stated explicitly: (1) SOLE — these pages appear in NO other episode of the coverage set. Ep 415 ('The Two Mangekyō', Narutopedia chapters=665,666; AFG window 1:30-13:09) stops at 'Kakashi rallies to Obito's side' — the exact sentence at which Narutopedia's ch-666 page breaks its own summary — and hands off to the flashback; ep 416 carries no chapter field on either source; ep 418 = 667-668 and ep 419 = 668. (2) MAJOR PLOT POINT — the paired-Kamui transfer that gets Obito into his own dimension and the START of the Tailed Beast Transfer Technique on Naruto is the act the entire following arc rests on (Naruto's revival, ch 671-673 / eps 420-424), and the chapter's closing panel — Guy arriving to save Kakashi — is the hinge into the Eight Gates run. Not a cameo, not a restaged scene: the episode animates the chapter to its last page and the next episode opens on 667. This is exactly the failure the exception exists to prevent — left filler, the catalog would mark ch 666's final pages never-adapted and would tell the reader ep 415 finished the chapter. WHO LIED: AFL, which block-typed the 416-417 flashback pair as filler and never looked at the episode's last five minutes. AFG's blue class is RIGHT here and its minute note is what sizes it. Independent legs: ja-WP leaves 417 UNMARKED while bolding 416, 422, 423, 427, 428, 429, 430 and 431 around it (an under-marking legend — an unmarked row among marked neighbours is the positive claim); TV Tokyo's own 第637話 synopsis closes '――そして舞台は戻りマダラと対峙するオビトとカカシ。二人の最後の作戦が今始まる!!'.

CONFIRMED AS STORED — a confirmation is a result. AFL is RIGHT; animefillerguide's blue 'Mixed' class is the lie, and AFG's own note is what convicts it: 'in this episode we only watch from 0:00 to 0:30' — thirty seconds. Per-segment weights: (a) 0:00-0:30, ch 678, weight SLIVER (B falls under the Infinite Tsukuyomi; a duplicate — 678 is adapted in eps 451 and 458, 677 in 426; not sole, and not a death/reveal/arc close, so the exception does not fire); (b) the remaining ~20½ minutes, weight n/a — 100% anime-original: B, Yugito, Matatabi and Gyūki as chibi familiars, the raid on Sunagakure for Gaara, Naruto imprisoned in the Hokage Rock. T27: zero standing in the source outside the sliver → filler. Independent legs: ja-WP BOLDS the subtitle 「キラービー落風伝・天の巻」 (legend: bold = 全編アニメオリジナル) with the unmarked canon rows 414/415/417/418 in the same table as controls; TV Tokyo's 第649話 synopsis is the dream from its first words ('無限月読にかかったキラービーが見る夢――') to its last; Narutopedia's Killer B article writes the whole scenario as 'In the anime, Killer B dreamed of a world where…' citing episodes 429 and 430.

Stored MIXED (AFL + a batch-15 promotion of Narutopedia's chapters=681). TRUE: FILLER, and the stored manual anchor must be deleted (A1 — see repairs). Per-segment weights: (a) the Black Zetsu narration frame, ch 681, weight SLIVER — a cut-back that opens the episode ('Black Zetsu begins telling Naruto and Sasuke the tale of Kaguya'), duplicating pages ep 459 already animated and that ep 462 animates properly; (b) the whole remainder — the meteorite and the God Tree, Kaguya descending from the sky, emperor Tenji and the 祖の国, the servant Aino, the ministers Suzaku and Genbu, the lake dispute with the Land of That, the execution decree, the archers — weight n/a, anime-original with anime-original characters; (c) the closing beat (the chakra fruit, the Rinne Sharingan, the Infinite Tsukuyomi) — a RESTAGING of Hagoromo's ch 670-671 account already animated in eps 420-421, a duplicate. Nothing first-time from the manga in the episode at all, so T27 gives filler and the sole-adaptation exception cannot fire on either half. WHO LIED: AFL (its 'Mixed Canon/Filler' bucket). AFG is RIGHT here — red, chapter N/A, on a column that discriminates (459 = 679,680,681; 462 = 681; 463 = 681,682,683). Independent legs: ja-WP BOLDS 「大筒木カグヤ」 with 459, 462, 463 and 470 unmarked around it, and its アニメ版オリジナルストーリー entry for this arc states 'カグヤの過去は完全にアニメオリジナルであり'; TV Tokyo's 第680話 synopsis is Tenji and the 祖の国 start to finish. Narutopedia's own Kaguya article prefixes this material 'In the anime, Kaguya was discovered by the people of the Land of Ancestors' with ref NS460.

Stored MIXED; TRUE: FILLER, stored manual anchor to be deleted (A1). Per-segment weights: (a) the ch-681 narration frame, weight SLIVER ('Black Zetsu continues telling Kaguya's story'), a duplicate of pages ep 462 adapts properly; (b) the entire remainder — Gamamaru damming the stream and driving off the bear, the farmers' water dispute, the fraudulent medicine salesman, Haori and the God-Tree ritual, the bodies bound in the roots beyond the Peak of Demise, Hagoromo's Sharingan awakening, the Memory Stone at Mount Myōboku, Gamamaru's prophecy and the Sage-power training — weight n/a, anime-original. No first-time manga page; the exception cannot fire. WHO LIED: AFL. AFG (red, N/A) is right. Independent legs: ja-WP BOLDS 「ハゴロモとハムラ」 (with 459/462/463/470 unmarked) and states the Kaguya past is entirely anime-original; TV Tokyo's 第681話 synopsis is Gamamaru and the 終焉の峠 start to finish; Narutopedia's Kaguya article cites episode 461 for the anime-only detail that she revived and mind-wiped some Infinite Tsukuyomi victims.

Stored MIXED (AFL alone); TRUE: FILLER. Per-segment weights: there is no source segment to weigh. The episode is one continuous anime-original comedy — Team 7 (with Sasuke, under the Third Hokage, i.e. Part I time) trying to see Kakashi's face, aided by the photographer Sukea who turns out to BE Kakashi. Sukea is anime-original: Narutopedia has no article for him ('Sukea' redirects to Kakashi Hatake) and the reveal of Kakashi's face happens here, in the anime, years before any manga page shows it. Narutopedia's episode page carries NO chapters field and NO arc field — silence, but framed by positive chapter fields on 459, 462, 463 and 470 either side, which makes the silence readable; AFG marks it red with N/A; ja-WP BOLDS 「特別任務」 (bold = 全編アニメオリジナル) with 470 繋がる思い unmarked immediately after; TV Tokyo's 第689話 back-number entry is a two-line teaser ('ついにあの"真実"がここに―― 君は、この伝説を見逃すな。') with no story content to tie to a chapter. Not one source names a chapter. WHO LIED: AFL — its 'Mixed Canon/Filler' class here is unsupported by every other witness, and the AFL 'Anime Canon' / 'Mixed' buckets are not type witnesses (wave-1 lesson).

repairs.old: 681 [681] {681 (Black Zetsu's account of Kaguya's arrival, Tenji, the chakra fruit and the first Infinite Tsukuyomi — 'Kaguya's Tears' narration frame, heavily expanded with anime-original backstory)} v71 (manual)
repairs.why: A1 — the row is filler under the type correction, and the value was never a position: ch 681's pages are wholly covered by eps 459 / 462 / 463, and what ep 460 dramatises (Tenji, Aino, the Land of Ancestors) is not in ch 681 or in any chapter. Not a contradiction of the batch-15 ruling's FACTS — that verdict recorded the disagreement honestly ('Narutopedia lists ch 681; animefillerguide marks 460 filler; animefillerlist keeps it Mixed') and promoted the frame to an anchor. What has changed is the RULE: the sliver clause (Sean 2026-09-04) requires every source segment to be weighed SIGNIFICANT or SLIVER and forbids a sliver from earning a type or an anchor, and the sole-adaptation exception (2026-08-28) supplies the only route to keeping it — which fails here on both halves (not sole; not a major plot point). The stored continue 681/parity goes with the anchor; the zone's continue is unaffected because ep 462 still anchors 681.

repairs.old: 681 [681] {681 (Black Zetsu's narration continues: Hagoromo and Hamura's youth, Gamamaru, the God Tree ritual — almost entirely anime-original expansion around the 681 frame)} v71 (manual)
repairs.why: A1, same shape as ep 460 — and the stored note already says the quiet part ('almost entirely anime-original expansion around the 681 frame'). A frame is a sliver; a sliver takes no anchor. Ch 681 keeps its position on eps 459, 462 and 463.

repairs.new: 665, 666 (opening half: Obito refuses Madara's hand and pierces him, extracts fragments of Shukaku's and Gyūki's chakra, orders Kakashi to teleport Naruto and Sakura to Kamui's dimension, Madara's orb stops him going himself, Kakashi rallies to his side — ch 666's closing third is animated at the end of ep 417, after the anime-original 416-417 flashback)
repairs.why: OUTSIDE THE ASK but produced by it: the stored '665-666' asserts ch 666 is complete after ep 415, which is false and hides the ep-417 finding. Narutopedia's ep-415 summary ends on 'Kakashi runs to Obito's side… remembering the old times in Konohagakure', which is precisely where Narutopedia's ch-666 page breaks its own summary; AFG's ep-415 window (1:30-13:09) leaves the episode's last ~8 minutes to the flashback's opening. Note + continue only — ep 415's END (666), START (665) and volume are unchanged, because ep 415 does adapt the bulk of 666 (A4; A47 does not apply — this is not a ≤5-page or teaser-worded scrap).

repairs.old: eps 459,460,461,462 rearranged {679-681} — 'ch 681 stretched across four eps' (batch 12)
repairs.new: eps 459,462 (and 463) — ch 681 is split across eps 459 / 462 / 463, NOT four ways: 459 runs to Black Zetsu beginning the tale, 462 animates the tale (AFG 10:40 → end), 463 carries 681-683. Eps 460 and 461 hold only the narration frame (see the graft{681} sliver annotation) and are filler.
repairs.why: The stored group annotation is the record that made eps 460/461 look anchorable. Narrowing it keeps the true fact (ch 681 is stretched) while removing the false implication that 460 and 461 carry a share of it. Curation note for Sean: 'rearranged' is arguably the wrong kind even for 459/462 — 679→680→681 runs in order and the shape is a single chapter stretched, i.e. `partial`. I flag it rather than silently re-kind an annotation outside the ask.

repairs.old: continue 681/parity — 'ep 460 starts ch 681; ch 681 straddles the episode boundary — ep 460 finishes it'
repairs.new: continue 681 (C1) — ep 459 stops inside ch 681, at Black Zetsu beginning his account; eps 460-461 are anime-original expansion carrying only the narration frame, and ep 462 resumes ch 681's own pages at ~10:40. Resume IN ch 681.
repairs.why: Note-only: the VALUE (681) is unchanged and stays correct after the two anchor deletions, because ep 462 still anchors 681. Only the sentence 'ep 460 finishes it' becomes false.

structure.notes:
1) THE JOIN. Our row numbers, Narutopedia's `episode=` field and AFL's/AFG's row numbers all agree 1:1 on this block (417/429/460/461/469 verified individually on title AND air date: 2015-06-25, 2015-09-10, 2016-05-12, 2016-05-19, 2016-07-28). ja-WP and TV Tokyo use 通算話 (cumulative episode) numbering — 417 = 第637話, 429 = 第649話, 460 = 第680話, 461 = 第681話, 469 = 第689話 — and the join is printed in ja-WP's own 話数 / 通算話 column pair. TV Tokyo's back-number pages are chunked (episodes34 = 626-637, episodes35 = 638-651, episodes38 = 675-686, episodes39 = 687-697); the finale 第720話 = our ep 500 confirms the offset end to end. WARNING for anyone reusing this join: ja-WP's 通算話 is a cumulative EPISODE number, never a chapter (the shippuden trap from wave 11) — 461 = 通算第681話 and ch 681 is a coincidence of exactly the kind that fabricates anchors.

2) ja-WP'S MARKER IS THE INSTRUMENT ON THIS SERIES.
